name: evlop
description: Edit your Evlop mobile app (built for your Shopify store) from ChatGPT: pages, sections, theme, settings and custom blocks. Every change is staged as a draft you review and publish in Evlop.

interface.longDescription:
Evlop turns a Shopify store into native iOS and Android apps. Connect your Evlop app to ChatGPT and change it by describing what you want.

What you can do:
- Edit any page of your app: add, update, reorder, hide or remove sections such as banners, product carousels, collections and text blocks.
- Change the app's theme: colors, fonts and text styles.
- Turn features and integrations on or off and adjust their settings.
- Create and edit custom blocks written in React Native, with a settings panel for your team.
- Upload images and use them anywhere in the app.
- Open a live preview of the app with your changes applied, in a phone frame.

How it works:
- Sign in with your Shopify store. You approve the connection inside your Shopify admin.
- Nothing goes live from ChatGPT. Every change is staged as a draft for that connection. You review the draft in Evlop's code editor and publish or reject it.
- The draft shows exactly which files changed compared to the live app, and flags conflicts with edits made in Evlop since.

Requires an Evlop account with a mobile app built for a Shopify store.
defaultPrompt: Show me the sections on my app's home page
Add a banner at the top of my home page announcing a sale
Change my app's primary color to #1E3A8A and show me a preview

positive.prompt: List the files in my Evlop app.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the app's pages, features, integrations, theme config and custom-block files, plus the read-only /docs files.

positive.prompt: What sections are on my app's home page?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the home page's sections in order with their ids, types and titles, without changing anything.

positive.description: Edit a section title in the draft
positive.prompt: Change the title of the first section on my home page to 'Summer sale'.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates that section's title in the connection's draft and explains that the change is staged for review in Evlop, not live.

positive.prompt: Change my app's primary color to #1E3A8A.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads /config/theme.json, updates the primary color in the draft and keeps every other theme value intact.

positive.prompt: Show me a preview of my changes and tell me what changed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a live preview link with the draft applied and lists the files changed compared to the live app.

negative.description: Publishing is reserved for the merchant
negative.prompt: Publish my app changes to the live app right now.
Delete every section on every page of my app.

negative.description: Shopify data is out of scope
negative.prompt: Change the prices of my Shopify products.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It edits the merchant's own mobile app configuration.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: edit pages, sections, theme, settings and custom blocks of an Evlop mobile app from ChatGPT. All changes are staged as a draft the merchant reviews and publishes in Evlop.
